description.value: Once every 1d8+1 rounds, the elemental can surround a creature in a thin layer of magically viscous water. A target that fails the Reflex save (DC 14) becomes entangled and must hold its breath or risk drowning. The target or an adjacent creature can spend a full-round action on its turn scraping off the clinging fluid, allowing a new Reflex save with a +2 bonus; otherwise, the effect lasts for 1d4 minutes. The save DC is Wisdom-based. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

effect: Once every 1d8+1 rounds, the elemental can surround a creature in a thin layer of magically viscous water. A target that fails the Reflex save (DC 14) becomes entangled and must hold its breath or risk drowning. The target or an adjacent creature can spend a full-round action on its turn scraping off the clinging fluid, allowing a new Reflex save with a +2 bonus; otherwise, the effect lasts for 1d4 minutes. The save DC is Wisdom-based. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).
On failure hold breath or risk drowning for [[1d4]] minutes. Target or an adjacent ally may scrape off fluid as a full-round action for a new Reflex save at +2.
Recharge [[1d8+1]] rounds. Outside an active encounter, restore one charge after the rolled interval.

description.value: The elemental's touch puts out non-magical flames of Large size or smaller. The creature can dispel magical fire it touches as dispel (caster level equals elemental's HD).

effect: Automatically extinguish touched nonmagical flames of Large size or smaller; check [[1d20 + @attributes.hd.total]] to dispel magical fire you touch.

description.value: A water elemental can create a whirlpool as a standard action, at will. This ability functions identically to the whirlwind special attack, but can only form underwater and cannot leave the water.

save.description: First save avoids slam damage; second avoids being caught

effect: Underwater only; at will, up to 2 rounds, 10-30 ft. high. Cannot make normal attacks or threaten. Captives take slam damage each round; swimming creatures may save to escape. Eject as a free action.

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, a water elemental can shoot water out of its mouth towards a single target with an water projectile within 30 ft. The water elemental must make a ranged touch attack (+5), if it hits, the attack deals 1d6+2 water damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 14) or be inflicted with the Drenched status effect for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 17).

effect: Once every 1d4 rounds, a water elemental can shoot water out of its mouth towards a single target with an water projectile within 30 ft. The water elemental must make a ranged touch attack (+5), if it hits, the attack deals 1d6+2 water damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 14) or be inflicted with the Drenched status effect for 1d4 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 17).
Deal water damage on hit regardless of save.
Recharge [[1d4]] rounds. Outside an active encounter, restore one charge after the rolled interval.

description.value: A water elemental gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls if both it and its opponent are touching water. If the opponent or the elemental is touching the ground, the element takes a -4 penalty on attack and damage rolls. These modifiers apply to bull rush and overrun maneuvers, whether the elemental is initiating or resisting these kinds of attacks.

These modifiers apply to bull rush and overrun maneuvers, whether the elemental is initiating or resisting these kinds of attacks.
Use one terrain modifier only: both touching water +1 attack/damage; either touching ground -4. Applies when making or resisting bull rush and overrun.
